description: Gene Ontology terms in the biological_process namespace, representing biological processes.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Primary Gene Ontology term identifier, such as GO:0008150.

common_properties.name: definition
common_properties.description: Formal definition of the GO term.

common_properties.name: license
common_properties.description: License for the ontology structure and term definitions.

common_properties.name: url
common_properties.description: Canonical, stable, resolvable OBO URL for the GO term.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time of the most recent creation or update of the node.

source_contributions.scope: Non-obsolete biological_process terms with 2–1000 annotated human genes, inclusive, after annotation propagation.
source_contributions.description: GO supplies term labels, definitions, alternative names, identifiers, and external cross-references. Term inclusion uses human NCBI gene2go annotations and associations propagated through is_a and part_of relationships, including cross-namespace part_of relationships. Negative (NOT) annotations are excluded, and a NOT annotation removes the gene from that term even if propagation would otherwise associate it. The GO hierarchy is not exposed as graph edges.

properties.name: synonyms
properties.description: Alternative term names from all GO synonym categories: EXACT, RELATED, BROAD, and NARROW.

properties.name: xrefs
properties.description: Cross-references to external databases, such as EC, Reactome, and MetaCyc.

properties.name: aliases
properties.description: Alternative GO identifiers for the same term.
